 Mr. M.A.Deo, counsel for Applicant.
 Mr. T.H.Udeshi, App for Non-applicant/State.
 Coram : Urmila Joshi-Phalke, J.
Dated : 11/06/2024.
1. Apprehending the arrest at the hands of Police, in connection with Crime No. 440/2024
registered with Police Station Gadchiroli for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 and
120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant approached this Court for grant of pre- arrest
bail.

2.  The applicant is apprehending arrest at the hands of Police as crime is registered on the basis of report lodged by Auditor - Bhaskar Haribhau Pathare, on an allegation that the husband of the present applicant was working in Gondwana University, and while working in Gondwana University committed the misappropriation worth of Rs. 1,46,58,316/-.
Out of which, amount approximately Rs.18,31,618/- is transferred to the joint account of the present applicant and her husband.
3. Learned counsel Mr. M.A. Deo for the applicant submitted that as far as the present applicant is concerned, rkn 2 10aba406.2024.odt she is not at all concerned with the said transaction.
The joint account is also operated by her husband.
Her mobile number is also not registered or connected with the said account.
The notice received by the present applicant from the Gondwana University is replied by her, wherein she has already mentioned that it was her husband, who was operating the said account.
Her husband has voluntarily surrendered before the Police Authority, and he is in custody.
The applicant is having small child of one and half year, her immediate custodial interrogation is not required.
In view of that, she be protected by granting ad- interim protection.
4. Learned APP strongly opposed the present application and submitted that in absence of the investigation papers, the role of the present applicant cannot be ascertained.

She further submitted that considering the fact that the amount of Rs. 18,31,618/- is already transferred in the joint account of the present applicant and other co-accused, who is her husband, her custodial Priya Manohar Pagade vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr.

In view of that, the prayer for grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be rejected.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State.

Perused the recitals of the FIR from which, it reveals that the accused who is the husband of the present applicant serving in Gondwana University and was holding the charge of Accounts Department, he rkn 3 10aba406.2024.odt has committed a misappropriation of huge amount.

It further reveals from the communication that Gondwana University has issued the notice to the present applicant, wherein it is alleged that the amount of Rs. 18,31,618/- is transferred to the joint account of the present applicant and her husband.
The said notice is replied by the present applicant stating that it was her husband who was operating the said account.
Her mobile number is also not connected with the account and therefore, she is not aware regarding the transaction which taken place in the said account.
In view of that, her immediate custodial interrogation is not required.
As far as the interrogation part is concerned, some conditions can be imposed.

In view of that, I proceed to pass following order:
a] In the event of her arrest, the applicant - Ms. Priya Manohar Pagade, shall be released on ad- interim anticipatory bail, in connection with Crime No. 440/2024 registered with Police Station Gadchiroli for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, on executing P.R. Bond of Rs.
25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
b] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week on Saturday between 10.00 a.m. to 01.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
rkn 4 10aba406.2024.odt c]

The applicant shall not induce, threat or promise any witnesses who are acquainted with the facts of the present case.
6. Place the matter after two weeks.
[URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.] Signed by: Mr. R.K. NANDURKAR rkn
